summary_en: Sanwa Holdings raised its DOE (dividend on equity) target from 10% to 15% effective from the fiscal year ending March 2027. The company increased its dividend per share forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 from 73 yen to 96 yen, including a 7 yen commemorative dividend, reflecting the new policy aimed at more active shareholder returns and improved capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Dividend Policy and Revision of Dividend per Share Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Sanwa Holdings Corporation announced on October 30, 2026, that its Board of Directors has approved changes to its dividend policy and revised dividend forecasts for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.

The company raised its dividend on equity (DOE) target from 10% to 15%, effective from the fiscal year ending March 2027. This increase reflects the company's commitment to deliver more active shareholder returns while maintaining strong capital efficiency and a sound financial base. The higher DOE target aligns with the company's strategy to optimize its capital structure.

As a result, the company revised its dividend per share forecast for fiscal 2027 from the previously projected 73 yen (including a 7 yen commemorative dividend) to 96 yen (including the same 7 yen commemorative dividend), representing a 23 yen increase. The ordinary dividend component was raised from 66 yen at mid-year and 66 yen at fiscal year-end to 89 yen at mid-year and 66 yen at fiscal year-end, with the total ordinary dividend for the full year increasing from 132 yen to 155 yen. The policy change applies to dividends from fiscal 2027 onwards.
